plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Huawei ATN series routers. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, temperature, fan, power supply status, optical modules, interface traffic, voltage, and power (enterprise PEN 2011).
name: Router

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Per-entity CPU utilization of the Huawei ATN device control plane (hwEntityCpuUsage), normalized to a 0-100 percentage. Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload, routing instability, or attack traffic, and may lead to slow management response or packet processing delays.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Per-entity memory utilization of the Huawei ATN device (hwEntityMemUsage), reported directly as a 0-100 percentage. Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. High memory usage may indicate memory leaks, oversized routing tables, or insufficient capacity, and can cause instability or failed allocations.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports the temperature reading of each Huawei hardware sensor (hwEntityTemperature), in degrees Celsius. Abnormally high temperatures may indicate fan failure, blocked airflow, or excessive ambient heat, and can trigger thermal protection or hardware damage if left unaddressed.

metrics.name: device_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Per-entity input voltage of the Huawei ATN device (hwEntityVoltage). The device reports millivolts; the query divides by 1000 to display volts. Values outside the rated range may indicate unstable power and hardware risk.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the operational state of each Huawei cooling fan (hwEntityFanState). Huawei reports a binary state where 1 means normal and 2 means abnormal; any value other than normal indicates a cooling fault that can quickly lead to overheating and should be investigated immediately. Dimension index is the fan table row index (hwEntityFanIndex is not a description).

metrics.name: device_optical_rx_power
metrics.description: Per-module SFP/optical receive power in dBm (hwEntityOpticalRxPower). The device reports uW; Telegraf stores raw uW and this query converts with 10*log10(uW/1000), dropping <=0 (invalid/no-module). Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. A dropping RX level is an early sign of fiber attenuation, dirty optics, or a failing peer transmitter.

metrics.name: device_optical_tx_power
metrics.description: Per-module SFP/optical transmit power in dBm (hwEntityOpticalTxPower). The device reports uW; Telegraf stores raw uW and this query converts with 10*log10(uW/1000), dropping <=0 (invalid/no-module). Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. An abnormally low TX level indicates a failing laser/optic rather than fiber attenuation alone.

metrics.name: device_cpu_dev_duty
metrics.description: Instantaneous CPU duty of each Huawei ATN CPU device entry (hwCpuDevDuty), reported as a 0-100 percentage. Complements per-entity hwEntityCpuUsage for control-plane load on ATN platforms.

metrics.name: device_cpu_dev_avg_duty_1min
metrics.description: One-minute average CPU duty of each Huawei ATN CPU device entry (hwAvgDuty1min), reported as a 0-100 percentage. Use this to smooth short spikes when judging control-plane pressure.

metrics.name: device_cpu_dev_avg_duty_5min
metrics.description: Five-minute average CPU duty of each Huawei ATN CPU device entry (hwAvgDuty5min), reported as a 0-100 percentage. Sustained elevation points to lasting control-plane load rather than a brief burst.

metrics.name: device_memory_dev_size
metrics.description: Total memory size of each Huawei ATN memory device entry (hwMemoryDevSize64), in bytes. Together with free memory it shows capacity remaining on the forwarding/control memory pool.

metrics.name: device_memory_dev_free
metrics.description: Free memory of each Huawei ATN memory device entry (hwMemoryDevFree64), in bytes. Persistently low free memory indicates rising memory pressure and risk of allocation failure.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each Huawei ATN power supply (hwEntityPwrState). On-wire INTEGER is supply(1)/notSupply(2)/sleep(3)/unknown(4), not a binary normal/abnormal. sleep(3) is a valid redundant-PSU energy-saving state, not a fault. Dimension index is the PSU table row index.

metrics.name: device_psu_present
metrics.description: Presence of each Huawei ATN power supply (hwEntityPwrPresent). Absent means the slot is empty or the module was pulled; combined with PSU state this confirms lost redundancy.

metrics.name: device_fan_speed
metrics.description: Fan rotation speed of each Huawei ATN cooling fan (hwEntityFanSpeed). Abnormally low or zero speed indicates a stalled or failed fan and a risk of overheating; abnormally high speed may indicate the device is compensating for high temperature.

metrics.name: device_fan_present
metrics.description: Presence of each Huawei ATN cooling fan (hwEntityFanPresent). Absent means the fan tray is missing; investigate immediately because cooling capacity is reduced.

metrics.name: device_entity_board_power
metrics.description: Board power consumption of each Huawei ATN entity (hwEntityBoardPower), in watts. Unexpected rise can indicate a failing board, abnormal traffic load, or a cooling problem that increases power draw.

metrics.name: device_power_used
metrics.description: Chassis-level used power of the Huawei ATN device (hwDevicePowerInfoUsedPower), in watts. Rising used power against a stable total budget indicates growing load or a hardware inefficiency.

metrics.name: device_power_total
metrics.description: Chassis-level total power capacity of the Huawei ATN device (hwDevicePowerInfoTotalPower), in watts. Used as the denominator when judging how close the chassis is to its power budget.

metrics.name: device_entity_oper_status
metrics.description: Operational status of each Huawei ATN entity (hwEntityOperStatus). Disabled or offline entities should be correlated with standby status and slot state to locate failed boards.

metrics.name: device_entity_standby_status
metrics.description: Standby status of each Huawei ATN entity (hwEntityStandbyStatus). Unexpected loss of providingService or hotStandby on a redundant board indicates a switchover or a failed standby.

metrics.name: device_optical_temperature
metrics.description: Temperature of each Huawei ATN optical module (hwEntityOpticalTemperature), in degrees Celsius. High module temperature accelerates laser aging and can precede optical power failure.

metrics.name: device_optical_bias
metrics.description: Laser bias current of each Huawei ATN optical module (hwEntityOpticalBiasCurrent). Drift away from the normal range is an early sign of a failing transmitter.

metrics.name: device_optical_voltage
metrics.description: Supply voltage of each Huawei ATN optical module (hwEntityOpticalVoltage). The device reports millivolts; the query divides by 1000 to display volts. Out-of-range voltage can cause unstable optics.

metrics.name: interface_ifAdminStatus
metrics.description: This metric indicates the administrative status of the network interface.

metrics.name: interface_ifOperStatus
metrics.description: This metric reflects the actual operational status of the network interface.

metrics.name: interface_ifSpeed
metrics.description: This metric indicates the maximum data transmission speed supported by the network interface.

metrics.name: interface_ifHighSpeed
metrics.description: Interface speed in megabits per second from IF-MIB ifHighSpeed. Used together with ifSpeed so high-rate ATN ports are not capped by the 32-bit ifSpeed gauge.

metrics.name: interface_ifInErrors
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of incoming error packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifOutErrors
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of outgoing error packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifInDiscards
metrics.description: This metric represents the average rate of incoming discarded packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifOutDiscards
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of outgoing discarded packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifInUcastPkts
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of incoming unicast packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifOutUcastPkts
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of outgoing unicast packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: device_total_incoming_traffic
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of total bytes received by the entire device over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: device_total_outgoing_traffic
metrics.description: This metric represents the average rate of total bytes sent by the entire device over the past 5 minutes.
